Our Story

We Didn't Open a Gym.
We Built a Response.

Too many gyms are built to retain memberships, not create results. They count on you forgetting to cancel. We count on you never wanting to leave.

We opened Dany's Gym because we were tired of watching people pay for a place to walk on treadmills and call it a lifestyle change. A membership card doesn't transform you. An environment that demands something of you does.

So we built one. From the floor plan to the programming to the coaches we hired — everything here has one purpose: to make sure you're different when you walk out than when you walked in.

That's not a slogan. It's the only reason this place exists.

Things people ask before they commit.

Do I need to sign a contract?

No. Every plan is month-to-month. If we're not delivering, you leave. That's the deal.

What if I'm a complete beginner?

Good. We've coached everyone from first-timers to competitive athletes. We'll start where you are.

Can I access all training programs?

Core and Elite plans include all 4 programs — Indoor Strength, Outdoor HIIT, Boxing, and 1-on-1 PT. The Starter plan includes gym floor access and 2 Indoor Strength classes per week.

What are the gym hours?

Monday–Friday 5AM to 11PM. Saturday–Sunday 6AM to 9PM. Holiday hours via the app.
